sloka: विह्वलाभ्याम् च नेत्राभ्याम् अपश्यन्न् इव भूमिपः ।क्Rच्च्रात् धैर्येण सम्स्तभ्य कैकेयीम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-१४-१३॥
transliteration: vihvalābhyām ca netrābhyām apaśyann iva bhūmipaḥ ।kRccrāt dhairyeṇa samstabhya kaikeyīm idam abravīt ॥2-14-13॥

translations.english: The king was unable to see with his eyes overwhelmed (with tears). Gaining with great difficulty a firm footing and courage he addressed Kaikeyi:
